description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans one-way method calls, including both Task and ValueTask variants, tested from client and grain perspectives, verifying synchronous completion and fire-and-forget semantics.

classes.name: OneWayCallTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying Orleans one-way method call semantics, including synchronous return behavior and fire-and-forget patterns.

classes.name: SimpleGrainObserver
classes.description: A test observer implementing ISimpleGrainObserver to verify callback invocation and synchronization.

methods.name: OneWayMethodsReturnSynchronously_ViaClient
methods.description: Tests that Orleans one-way methods invoked from a client return immediately and complete synchronously.

methods.name: OneWayMethodReturnSynchronously_ViaGrain
methods.description: Verifies that grain-to-grain one-way calls complete immediately when invoked from one grain to another.

methods.name: OneWayMethodsReturnSynchronously_ViaClient_ValueTask
methods.description: Tests that ValueTask-based one-way methods complete synchronously when called from a client.

methods.name: OneWayMethodReturnSynchronously_ViaGrain_ValueTask
methods.description: Verifies that ValueTask-based grain-to-grain one-way calls complete immediately.
